key: Howdy! If your home is in need of repairs, just let me know!
en: Howdy! If your home is in need of repairs, just let me know!
ja: よお!家の修理が必要なら、いつでも声をかけてくれ!

key: All I ask is that you pay it forward. That's how things go around here, you know?
en: All I ask is that you pay it forward. That's how things go around here, you know?
ja: 頼みたいのはただ一つ、恩を次に送ってくれってことだけさ。ここじゃそうやって回ってるんだよ。

key: This place has been a lot quieter ever since that business in Rhodochrine came to a close.
en: This place has been a lot quieter ever since that business in Rhodochrine came to a close.
ja: ロドクラインの一件が片づいてから、この辺りはずいぶん静かになったな。

key: Shame, I was thinking I might have fun rising up to stop it myself.
en: Shame, I was thinking I might have fun rising up to stop it myself.
ja: 残念だよ、自分で立ち上がって止めてやろうかと思ってたのに。

key: I'm lucky that my part of Beryl survived the damage.
en: I'm lucky that my part of Beryl survived the damage.
ja: おれの住んでるベリルの一角が被害を免れて運が良かったよ。

key: Not only did I get to stay in my home, but I also got free upgrades when the restoration started!
en: Not only did I get to stay in my home, but I also got free upgrades when the restoration started!
ja: 家に住み続けられただけじゃなく、復興が始まったらタダで改修までしてもらえたんだ!

key: It's about time this place was patched up!
en: It's about time this place was patched up!
ja: この場所もそろそろ修復される頃合いだったんだよ!

key: Beryl was one of the first wards we worked on as a massive project, but even then it took sooooo long.
en: Beryl was one of the first wards we worked on as a massive project, but even then it took sooooo long.
ja: ベリルは最初に大規模な事業として手をつけたワードの一つなんだけど、それでもものすごく時間がかかったんだよ。

key: If you think all this happened overnight, you're crazy, no matter what it seems like!
en: If you think all this happened overnight, you're crazy, no matter what it seems like!
ja: これが一晩でできたなんて思ってるなら、どう見えたとしても頭がおかしいぞ!

key: <- Little Poe Street\n^v - Platinum Street
en: <- Little Poe Street\n^v - Platinum Street
ja: <- リトルポー通り\n^v -プラチナ通り

key: <- Kingsbury Street\nv - Emerald Street
en: <- Kingsbury Street\nv - Emerald Street
ja: <- キングズベリー通り\nv -エメラルド通り

key: Something unseeable is in the way.
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
ja: 見えない何かが道をふさいでいる。

key: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
en: \PN used the Silvon Scope.
ja: \PNはシルボンスコープを使った。

key: The startled Pokémon attacked!
en: The startled Pokémon attacked!
ja: 驚いたポケモンが攻撃してきた!

key: <- Stoker Road\n^ - Platinum Street\n>- Beryl Bridge
en: <- Stoker Road\n^ - Platinum Street\n>- Beryl Bridge
ja: <- ストーカー通り\n^ -プラチナ通り\n>-ベリル大橋

key: Much has changed.
en: Much has changed.
ja: 多くが変わった。

key: I do not know this city now.
en: I do not know this city now.
ja: 今のこの街を、私は知らない。

key: That is its strength.
en: That is its strength.
ja: それこそが、この街の強さだ。

key: The past is not worth clinging to.
en: The past is not worth clinging to.
ja: 過去にすがる価値などない。

key: Not when the future awaits.
en: Not when the future awaits.
ja: 未来が待っているのなら、なおさらだ。

key: Take this from me-- a memento of the past.
en: Take this from me-- a memento of the past.
ja: これを受け取ってくれ――過去の形見だ。

key: It is something like a good luck charm.
en: It is something like a good luck charm.
ja: お守りのようなものだ。

key: May it bring new things into your life.
en: May it bring new things into your life.
ja: これが君の人生に新しいものをもたらしますように。

key: Most things can be remade.
en: Most things can be remade.
ja: たいていのものは作り直せる。

key: Homes, people...
en: Homes, people...
ja: 家も、人も……

key: But not lives.
en: But not lives.
ja: だが、命は違う。

key: Those are our own to treasure.
en: Those are our own to treasure.
ja: それは私たち自身が大切にすべきものだ。
